about.description: FX-index perpetual on trade[XYZ] (Hyperunit) tracking the US Dollar Index (DXY), a basket measuring USD's value against a weighted set of major currencies (EUR, JPY, GBP, CAD, SEK, CHF), with pricing referencing Pyth / external FX reference methodology. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC on Hyperliquid (xyz namespace). Users gain synthetic DXY exposure without holding any underlying currency.
